# Read workspace text (workspace.read)

## categories

[
  "workspace",
  "files"
]

## demonstrations

[
  {
    "expected_output": {
      "exists": false,
      "path": "notes/plan.md"
    },
    "id": "missing",
    "input": {
      "path": "notes/plan.md"
    },
    "title": "Reading a file that does not exist yet"
  },
  {
    "deterministic": false,
    "explanation": "Runs against your own workspace, so the result depends on it.",
    "id": "page",
    "input": {
      "max_lines": 20,
      "path": "notes/plan.md",
      "start_line": 1
    },
    "title": "Read lines 1-20 of a file you wrote earlier"
  }
]

## description

Returns the text of a relative workspace file with its total line count. Use start_line and max_lines to page through long files; truncated is true when more lines follow. A missing file is not an error: exists is false. Reading never changes anything.

    "recovery": "Check the schema, permissions and relative path.",
    "symptom": "A validation or capability error."
  }
]

## limitations

[
  "UTF-8 text only; files over 5000000 bytes are refused.",
  "At most 100000 characters are returned per call; page with start_line.",
  "Forward-slash relative paths only; links and traversal are refused."
]
